hypothesis: AC60's group-0x60 preamble refreshes A909FC from the current page cells before command comparison for any safe 8-byte packet whose tag & 0xe0 is 0x60, including unknown tags 0x60, 0x62, and 0x70 as well as observed-undrawn 0x68. The preamble is suppressed only when the byte at BA01FC is nonzero.
falsifier: For any tested group-0x60 tag, a byte-zero gate fails to refresh the page cell, a byte-one gate refreshes it, or the adjacent-byte-only canary suppresses refresh. Any raster call or packet-relative access beyond the common 8-byte header also falsifies the stated safe-fallthrough assumption.
scope_limit: Finite discriminator for consumer fallthrough semantics only; it cannot establish any producer or first-party occurrence for 0x60, 0x62, or 0x70.
